Name: Paw Hunt
Author: sexynes
Description:
Required: 
[list]
[*]Use a hand mirror (purchased from Pierre for 1500g; need one for each player) 
[*]No spoiling 
[/list]
Recommended: [list]
[*]Obtain hand mirror ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense[/url]﻿) for every player before installing this mod 
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2213]Unlimited Players[/url] (might be outdated) 
[*]Use the lightest coloring when customizing 
[*]Play on a save file with plentiful coop/barn to hide among other animals 
[/list]
Issues: 
[list]
[*]When sitting beside and towards a table, subject may appear underneath the table
[/list]
Suggested Rules: 
[list]
[*]Must be conspicuous while hiding 
[*]Can not use map, social tab, or other advantages while as seeker 
[*]Everyone has the same viewing distance 
[*]Do not expose other known subjects unless requested 
[*]If not found after 4 in-game hours, players must change subject/location when safe to do so 
[*]Last subject yet to be found may state a hint 
[/list]
